'''''A Forbidden Love''''' was a play performed at the theater in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It involved a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] and a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]].
